name: halloween-checkin
description: Turn a photo of a real place into a reviewed day/night miniature building with a Halloween edition, and publish it to your Halloween Check-in site.

interface.shortDescription: Photo → day/night miniature, with a Halloween edition
interface.longDescription: Upload a photo of a place and say “checkin Halloween”. The skill makes four pictures, cuts them out and checks them; the tools submit them for your review and publish only when you ask.
defaultPrompt: checkin Halloween — here is my photo of this place
